Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.service

Class AuditEntry

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.service.AuditEntry
public class AuditEntry extends Object
One audit-trail record: who changed which petstore entity, how, and when.

PetStore appends one entry for every successful create, update or delete, whether it came from the /petstore API (actor "api") or from the console (actor "console:<user>"). Failed mutations append nothing. The Audit console page lists these entries.

Example:

PetStore store = new PetStore(); store.createPet(new Pet().setName("Rex"), "console:alice"); AuditEntry e = store.getAudit().get(0); // e.getEntity() = "Pet", e.getAction() = "CREATE", e.getDetail() = "Rex"
